test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: ________ substituted the planning commission in India.

options.text: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
National Institution for Transforming India (NITI Aayog)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Planning Commission in India was replaced by the National Institution for Transforming India (NITI Aayog).**
 
• **NITI Aayog**, or the National Institution for Transforming India, was established on January 1, 2015, as a policy think tank and advisory body to the Government of India.
 
• It serves as a platform for formulating and implementing policies and initiatives to promote** economic growth, sustainable development, and cooperative federalism in India.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Finance Commission:**

 
 
• The** Finance Commission** is a constitutional body in India that is responsible for recommending the distribution of financial resources between the central government and the state governments.
 
• It is constituted every five years and consists of a chairman and other members appointed by the President of India. 
 
 
 
• **Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)**:
 
 
• SEBI is the regulatory body for the securities market in India.
 
• It was established in 1992 and operates under the **Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992. **
 
 
 
• **Competition Commission of India (CCI)**:
 
 
• The Competition Commission of India is a statutory body that promotes and ensures fair competition in the market.
 
• It was established under the **Competition Act, 2002. **
